_about: Flow CSS class → the team base's Compose component (2026-11-05 study of 7 apps; names are the base kit in presentation/utils/composables unless a feature copy is noted). Used by build-flow --handoff and house-style.md. 'make' = the base has no shared component; build it as a small ad-free component.

t-btn.params: style = Linear (gradient) | Normal | Secondary; size = Big 52dp | Popup 44dp | Small 32dp; width = FullWidth (16dp margins) | Flexible | HalfWidth; isLoading
t-btn.note: size from the class: xl/xxl → Big, l → Popup, s/xs/m → Small

cta.params: size = Big (52dp; a 56dp CTA rounds to Big), width = FullWidth

cta56.params: size = Big, width = FullWidth or weight(1f) next to round icon buttons

btn.params: style from btn-filled → Linear/Normal, btn-tonal/btn-outlined → Secondary, btn-text → text button (make)

chipbtn.params: size = Small (32dp visual, 48dp hit area), width = Flexible

icon-btn.params: contentDescription = AppStrings label; keep the 48dp box even when the glyph is 24dp

round.note: favorite / share / back next to a CTA

t-header.params: title, onBack, actions; pads itself with WindowInsets.stableStatusBars

t-hero.params: 343 wide design unit via BoxWithConstraints; s-pill CTA bottom-left; HorizontalPager

t-pager.note: same geometry as the onboarding indicator

types.compose: Icon switch row (make: Row of weighted pills, selected weight 2 with label)
types.note: same idea as wallpaper_3d FloatingBottomNavigation (selected weight 1.8)

t-seg.compose: Segmented pill (make; e.g. preview HOME/LOCK toggle)

segtop.note: plus the eye button that hides controls in the real app

t-grid2.note: one aspect constant per item type; NativeExampleAd after row 3 then every 3 rows

wt.params: isLocked → PremiumBadge, type badge, GlideAsyncImage, aspectRatio

tile9.compose: PackCard (feature copy) with a scaled live preview

tag.compose: PremiumBadge or a small status badge (make)

badge-ty.compose: Type badge (make; wallpaper_3d shows the type glyph on cards)

pro-btn.compose: Premium entry in the top bar (icon + bounceClickOnce → paywall)

t-nav.params: enum HomeTab, rememberSaveable; BackHandler returns to the first tab

t-navpill.compose: FloatingBottomNavigation (gradient pill, selected weight 1.8 with label)

navbar.params: reserve its height (wallpaper_3d 88dp) in content padding

t-row.params: icon, title, value, chevron/switch (switch = PillSwitch, not M3 Switch)

switch.compose: PillSwitch (image or drawn pill; never M3 Switch)

searchbox.note: clear button 48dp hit area (wallpaper_3d SearchBox has a 20dp one)

t-dialog.params: buttonLayout = Single | Row | ColumnStacked; headerContent; adsContent; close icon

choices.compose: Equal choice tiles inside the sheet (feature)

ad-item.compose: NativeExampleAd (grid cell at the card aspect ratio)

ad-full.compose: Native full (SDK, between onboarding pages / transitions)
